protocol.name: wayland95_shell_v1
protocol.copyright: Wayland 95. This protocol is private to wayland95-compositor and its shell (win95shell); nothing else should use it.

interface.name: wayland95_shell_v1

description.summary: the compositor's link to its desktop shell

interface.description: The desktop's own keys are the shell's to act on (volume, brightness, the power and sleep buttons now; Ctrl+Esc and the others in later versions). The compositor catches them before any program sees them and sends them here, but only while a shell is bound: without one they go to the program with the keyboard as usual. Only one client may bind it at a time; a second gets the already_bound error.

entry.name: print
entry.summary: Print Screen: a picture of the whole screen

request.name: list_windows

description.summary: where the windows are, topmost first

request.description: For the screen capture tool's "a window": the windows on screen (not minimized), each as the rectangle it covers, frame included.

event.name: key

description.summary: one of the desktop's keys went down or up

event.description: Each press is followed by its release. The compositor doesn't repeat a held key: the shell does, if it wants to.

interface.name: wayland95_window_list_v1
interface.description: A window event for each window, topmost first, then done. Nothing more is sent; the client destroys it.
